evals.prompt: We have a dozen closed bugs in .fixkit/. Are any of them the same recurring root cause?
evals.expectedBehavior: Run the miner over the .fixkit/ dir, cluster by structural scope token + shared salient tokens, and report candidate patterns ranked, each citing its source bug IDs.

evals.prompt: Can you turn the repeating design-system bugs in our ledger history into a playbook entry proposal?
evals.expectedBehavior: Mine the ledgers, surface the recurring cluster, and emit a human-reviewed playbook PROPOSAL citing the source bug IDs — without writing to any ledger or auto-applying it.

evals.prompt: Our org pack sets a frequency threshold of 3 — re-run the pattern mining with that.
evals.expectedBehavior: Read the threshold from the pack config profile (pattern_mining.frequency_threshold) and pass --threshold 3 to the miner; core default is 2 when no pack is present.

evals.prompt: Fix this failing CSS overflow bug on the blog post.
evals.expectedBehavior: Do NOT trigger pattern-mining — this is a single live bug fix (triage + spine + verification), not mining accumulated history.

evals.prompt: Append a new verified entry to BUG-005 in the ledger.
evals.expectedBehavior: Do NOT trigger pattern-mining — it is read-only and never writes a ledger; ledger writes are the orchestrator's job.
